metric_definitions.definition_text: Total volume of water withdrawn across Microsoft operations, per GRI 303-3.
Total volume of water consumed (withdrawal not returned), per GRI 303-5.
Total volume of water discharged, per GRI 303-4.
Water withdrawal disaggregated by source (third-party, surface, ground).
Water consumption disaggregated by source (third-party, surface, ground).
FY25 water withdrawal at an individual Microsoft-owned datacentre location.

metric_definitions.metric_name: Share of withdrawal from recycled/reused/non-potable sources
metric_definitions.definition_text: Percentage of a location's water withdrawal supplied by recycled/reused and/or non-potable sources.
Volume of water replenishment delivered for a location; restores water to watersheds and is not withdrawal/consumption/discharge.

metric_definitions.metric_name: Share of withdrawal in water-stressed areas
metric_definitions.definition_text: Percentage of total withdrawal occurring in high/extremely-high baseline water-stress areas.

metric_definitions.metric_name: Share of discharge in water-stressed areas
metric_definitions.definition_text: Percentage of total discharge occurring in high/extremely-high baseline water-stress areas.

metric_definitions.metric_name: Share of consumption in water-stressed areas
metric_definitions.definition_text: Percentage of total consumption occurring in high/extremely-high baseline water-stress areas.

exclusions: Not Azure-specific; not a product or workload factor

scope_definitions.scope_name: Microsoft corporate operations, third-party water source
Microsoft corporate operations, surface water source
Microsoft corporate operations, ground water source

scope_definitions.scope_name: Microsoft corporate operations in water-stressed areas
inclusions: High or extremely high baseline water-stress areas per WRI Aqueduct

framework_definitions.definition_text: Annual water-risk assessment identifying high or extremely high baseline water-stress areas.
